·5··gas-powered baseload generation can provide reliable

·9··designed to bring the consistency needed by our

10··industry, but at what cost?··Tens of billions of dollars

11··in construction costs, which get socialized into

12··residential electric bills in the form of added

13··transmission fees, permanently affecting hundreds of

14··landowners, many of which are generational farmers and

15··ranchers, the permanent devaluation of tens of thousands

17··land in the state of Texas.

·7··obligation and the duty to consider all factors and

·9··of land from private landowners.

14··reliable local generation.
